ops.title: cc-transcript 14.7.0 released: arity unwrap + split_options + 6 security fixes
ops.body: 2026-07-19: tagged v14.7.0 (commit 3d7abb9) off rebased arity-unwrap-v2, PyPI publish green. Closes d026e9c (arity-aware Command.unwrapped: env -u/sudo -u/timeout 5s no longer hide the wrapped command; sudo SELinux/BSD value flags -r/-t/-c/-a covered) and ab9111e (per-arg Word raw/value/span already shipped in v14.6; split_options returns Word tuples). Executable dequoting handled by v14.6 Word.value (None=expansion taint). Version call: forced 14.7.0 (minor) despite tip carrying another session's 'BREAKING (next major)' judge/mining work — user's explicit call, tradeoff surfaced. Next: captain-hook pin >=14.7 + land evt.cmd (cmd-api branch reconcile in flight) + Phase C pack sweep collapsing deletions.py.
